response.sql: WITH entries AS (SELECT c.country, cs.wins FROM constructorStandings AS cs JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId WHERE c.country IS NOT NULL), country_averages AS (SELECT country, AVG(wins) AS avg_wins FROM entries GROUP BY country), overall AS (SELECT AVG(wins) AS avg_wins FROM entries), above_overall AS (SELECT ca.country, ca.avg_wins FROM country_averages AS ca CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE ca.avg_wins > o.avg_wins), group_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS avg_wins FROM above_overall) SELECT AVG(a.avg_wins) AS mean_wins, AVG(a.avg_wins - o.avg_wins) AS mean_above_overall, AVG(a.avg_wins - g.avg_wins) AS mean_above_group FROM above_overall AS a CROSS JOIN overall AS o CROSS JOIN group_average AS g WHERE a.avg_wins > g.avg_wins
